# PCAEdit

**Author:** Sen'ja<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![PCAEdit: screenshot 1](./pcaedit/img/pcaedit.png)

</div>

This program is intended for editing the `graphcach.pca` file, which stores the phone's power-on and power-off animations. The first eight images belong to the power-on animation, and the next eight belong to the power-off animation. You can replace them with your own images and save the modified PCA file.

The size of the inserted images must match the original.
